title: Girl Lynn Holding Doll, San Rafael Garden - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming snapshot portrait of a 5-and-a-half-year-old girl named Lynn standing outdoors in a lush garden filled with shrubs and flowering plants, clutching a small baby doll in her arms. She wears a puffed-sleeve dress and looks directly into the camera. Handwritten annotations on the front border indicate the location as 90 Crescent Drive in San Rafael, California. The reverse is plain except for a blue stamped number 72 in the lower right corner.
